messages:
tyler (AE): Hey team — DataBank's security team sent a questionnaire focused on access control. They want concrete evidence for SSO/SAML metadata, MFA enforcement policy, RBAC roles and least-privilege guidance. POC starts Mon. Can we assemble answers + artifacts by EOD Fri?

james (SE): Yep. Do we have a canonical doc for SSO metadata + example SAML metadata URL we can hand them? Also need an explicit statement about whether MFA is enforced for console/API users.

alex (InfoSec): Short answers first: we support SSO via SAML 2.0 and OIDC, customers can enforce MFA at the IdP level. For Redwood Console access we recommend IdP-enforced MFA for Private/Dedicated; for Hosted accounts we also support enforced SSO to require MFA. For API clients we use scoped API keys + optional short-lived service tokens.

alex (InfoSec): Evidence we can provide:
- SAML metadata endpoint (example): `https://idp.customer.example/saml/metadata` (we also publish our SP metadata at `https://console.redwood.ai/saml/metadata`)
- Snapshot of our RBAC role matrix (org-admin, org-auditor, project-admin, developer, read-only) — I can attach the CSV export.
- Excerpt from our Access Control policy (doc link): https://redwood.internal/policies/access-control (redwood-sec view only)
- Configuration screenshot showing "Require SSO + IdP MFA" toggle in Console (I'll add export).

james (SE): Can you drop the RBAC CSV and the Console screenshot into a shareable folder? Customer asked for a signed statement asserting "least privilege by default" and how default roles are scoped.

alex (InfoSec): I'll draft a short attestation paragraph we can sign. High-level text: "By default, new orgs are provisioned with least-privilege roles. Admin privileges are separate from developer roles; service tokens do not grant console admin. Customers can create custom roles with narrower permissions." Will attach as PDF.

maria (PS): For the POC we should also include a minimal example showing how to create a read-only API key and a scoped role via the API. I can add a snippet:
```
# create a scoped API key (example)
POST /v1/orgs/{org_id}/api-keys
{
  "name": "poc-readonly",
  "scopes": ["embeddings.read","models.list"],
  "expires_in": "7d"
}
```

james (SE): Perfect. Also FYI the customer asked whether we support enforced MFA for CLI/SDK flows — answer: MFA is enforced via IdP for interactive login flows; programmatic access should use short-lived tokens from federated sessions. I'll add that note.

tyler (AE): Nice. Timeline: Alex — can you post artifacts & attestation by 17:00 PST Friday? Maria — add the API snippet and a quick how-to for creating scoped roles. James — I'll consolidate into the SIG questionnaire template and submit.

alex (InfoSec): Will do. Attestation draft below, please review: "Redwood Inference implements role-based access controls and encourages least-privilege by default. Customers may enforce SSO via SAML/OIDC and require MFA at the identity provider. For programmatic access we provide scoped API keys and support short-lived federated tokens; management plane access requires the same identity controls as console access"

james (SE): LGTM with one tweak: add sentence that service tokens are isolated and do not provide org-admin unless explicitly granted.

alex (InfoSec): Added that sentence. Uploading CSV + screenshot + signed-attestation.pdf to share: https://files.redwood.ai/share/databank-iam-evidence (internal link)

deploy-bot: Deployment notice — artifacts folder created at https://files.redwood.ai/share/databank-iam-evidence (id: f7a1c9) :white_check_mark:

maria (PS): I've added the API example and a one-page "least privilege checklist" to the folder. Linking the direct files:
- RBAC_matrix.csv -> https://files.redwood.ai/share/databank-iam-evidence/RBAC_matrix.csv
- console-mfa-toggle.png -> https://files.redwood.ai/share/databank-iam-evidence/console-mfa-toggle.png
- attestation-signed.pdf -> https://files.redwood.ai/share/databank-iam-evidence/attestation-signed.pdf
- poc-readonly-snippet.md -> https://files.redwood.ai/share/databank-iam-evidence/poc-readonly-snippet.md

tyler (AE): Great work. I'll drop those links into the customer's SIG questionnaire and ask for a follow-up call Mon 10am to walk through details. If they push for SOC2 artifacts, loop in legal to handle redaction. :thumbsup:
